details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded a net outflow of $213.9 million on June 10, with BlackRock's IBIT losing $148.5 million. Ethereum ETFs also experienced a net outflow of $35.5 million, highlighting continued pressure on major funds.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs Face Major Outflows on June 10

details: Wintermute analysts report no signs of sustained capital inflows returning to Bitcoin following its recent price drop. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded 10 consecutive sessions of net outflows since May 30, with total losses around $2.97 billion, and stablecoin reserves on exchanges are declining.
title: Wintermute: No Signs of Bitcoin Capital Return, Bottom Unconfirmed

details: Ethereum (ETH) dropped to $1,611 on June 10, nearing the crucial $1,500 support level, causing significant investor concern. Market sentiment has declined, with long positions disappearing, though some investors are buying the dip, acquiring 127,000 ETH in 24 hours.
title: Ethereum Price Drops to $1,611, Critical Support Looms

details: Ripple (XRP) has announced a partnership with Mastercard to enhance its payment solutions. This collaboration comes amidst ongoing regulatory scrutiny and aims to integrate XRP's technology within Mastercard's network.
title: Ripple (XRP) Partners with Mastercard for Payment Solutions

details: Humanity Protocol (H) experienced a $36 million hack due to stolen private keys via an employee's laptop. The token initially crashed but rebounded over 55% intraday after the project launched a $1 million bounty and pledged buybacks.
title: Humanity Protocol Hacked for $36 Million, Token Rebounds

details: Japan's SBI Shinsei Bank is set to introduce a new service allowing customers to receive cryptocurrency vouchers based on their account balances. These vouchers can be exchanged for Bitcoin, Ethereum, or XRP.
title: Japanese Bank SBI Shinsei to Launch Crypto Vouchers
